text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac and I must come to a conclusion regarding entering the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "First, after assuring her that there were no condition issues with racing, I decided to do a final check with her."
choice_data_list: As you are now, you can coexist with it.
As you are now, you can coexist with them.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Coexistence...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...With her dramatic success in this Senior year,
she firmly etched into the racing world
that she is the 'Queen' of this era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In other words, the current her would never again be drowned out by another's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Once, there truly was a moment
where Umamusume holding different Triple Crowns
stood side by side."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre and Gentildonna.
Throughout history, the two only ever clashed once, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both boasted overwhelming track records across eras,
establishing indisputable proof of their supreme strength.
Thus, the brilliance of both coexisted in harmony.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, Lucky Lilac could likely coexist with Almond Eye, just as Orfevre and the others once did.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, there is no need to force a match with Almond Eye
just to prove strength.
...To rephrase it that way, at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Bearing that premise in mind,
I asked her the very same question as last year."
choice_data_list: ...What should we do about the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That joke isn't funny at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Because of your eyes.
...It's obvious you don't really mean that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac is right.
Deep down, I already knew
what her answer would be—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...That was what I was aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A star who, with a magnificent running style, paints the hearts of all who watch with emotion,
never failing to captivate them.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "It was all for this. I endured, and I bloomed once again."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"To become a 'Queen' who never runs away,
and fears nothing...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Right now, there's nothing to hesitate over.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The old me who feared Ai-san and thought,
'As long as I can bloom here, that's enough'—
I've thrown that me away...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I am the "Queen"...! I am Lucky Lilac, and I fear nothing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Please let me run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: And stand proud. At the very front, dead center—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I will bloom more brilliantly than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That I am the true star.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac resolved
to enter the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh. Did I keep ya waitin'?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No.
I just got here a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear, then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...The weather's really nice today, isn't it?
The sunset is gorgeous too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Lala.
So, what was it you wanted to talk about—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Being in this classroom reminds me of it.
Of how intensely frustrated Ai-san looked.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-Where'd that come from out of nowhere?
Wait, when did that even happen...!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's a story from quite a while back.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that's correct.
That was a difficult question, but you prepared very well,
Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Aww yeah!
Prepping beforehand totally paid off!
Doesn't this make me look like a star?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Hm? Why's everyone lookin' at me—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Whoa, she looks super frustrated!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I remember! It was when I was stumped
on a question and didn't know the answer,
and then Lala got it right!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I remember for a while after that,
Ai-san's hand would shoot up super fast whenever questions were asked.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Because I thought to myself, 'I lost!'
So of course I have to go for the win...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yep.
Ai-san hasn't changed one bit since way back.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"She hates losing at anything and everything,
she'll challenge anyone, no matter what,
and she never doubts for a second that she's gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I've always
been annoyed by Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh—
L-Lara...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"When we were competin' for the Triple Tiara,
ya never changed one bit, didja?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Win. Win. Win.
I will definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how brilliant of a run I put on,
she never wavers. She never gets scared.
She just purely, relentlessly seeks victory—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The way she's completely invincible really pisses me off.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Because I thought that was my sole
prerogative as the "Queen"—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's over and done with.
From here on is today's main event.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――I'm entering the "Japan Cup" too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Ai-san.
It's all thanks to you shining invincible and bright—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I was finally able to face the parts of myself I simply refuse to compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I'm not giving up the spot you're trying to stand on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I've had enough of quietly standing by and watching
you be the only one who shines, once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'll fight. I'll bloom brilliantly for sure.
And when I do, I'll show ya what I'm made of."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That there exists a "Queen" in this world
that even you could never dethrone.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, fufufu.
Fufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Lala!
My heart is pounding so hard!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being so direct with me!
I felt every bit of your feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You really are incredible...!
Always, always
striving to be a strong "Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because your heart is so strong,
I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Look, there's that look in your eyes again.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Shining so brilliantly, shouting that I'm invincible,
that I won't lose to anyone, that I'm gonna win—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It seriously pisses me off.
And yet, it really is—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (And that is precisely why, I—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I ain't gonna lose.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As long as it stands supple through hardship, it will not snap.
It blossoms so brightly that eyes cannot help but be captivated.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Brace yerself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on...!
Ah, I can't wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's have the greatest showdown, Lala!
And I am going to... WIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A pledge exchanged in a classroom dyed in sunset crimson. Time accelerates toward the decisive battle—
